findings.text: The record describes one row of the second rendering check as a marker name in generated_nearby_names, and no such variable exists anywhere in the prompts tree; the block that row reports on reads nearby_existing_names at review_names.md:266, and the render claim it makes reproduces (nearby marker present at both revisions, roster marker absent at base and present at head), so this is a name a reader cannot resolve rather than a false statement.

The per-item reviewer builds its context with neither existing_names nor nearby_existing_names and renders sn/review_names_user at workers.py:8703, a template that includes no roster; a candidate judged on that path sees no catalog roster at all. Out of scope for this verdict: the landed change does not make it reachable, because nothing on that path supplies the variable, so nothing is discarded there. Reported because the goal is instrument-level and a reader of SOUND should know the roster still reaches no per-item reviewer.
